policy.canonical_witness_rule: Never substitute an external reproduction for the checksum-fixed working facsimile solely because edition/title metadata appear compatible. A public retrieval source may be canonical only after exact binary identity is verified against the fixed checksum.
policy.iiif_rule: A canonical IIIF mapping requires image-level identity or another reproducible machine link to the checksum-fixed working facsimile.
policy.negative_control_rule: Known nonidentical external reproductions are retained with measured mismatch evidence so later automation cannot silently promote them to canonical witness status.
